summary: Iteration 3 backend testing for NutriSnap v3: EN/IT language support across LLM endpoints and the new 'ingredients' meal-plan preset. Wrote 12 new tests at /app/backend/tests/test_lang_iter3.py covering analyze-food (default/en/it), meal-plan/generate (ingredients+en using chicken/rice/broccoli/olive oil/eggs; bilanciato+en checking meal_type keys remain colazione/pranzo/cena/spuntino; iperproteico+it; no-lang default), coach/recovery (en English statuses, it Italian statuses, no-lang default), coach/program (en), and coach/form-analysis (en, 4 real JPEG frames). 12/12 new tests passed. Also ran the legacy iteration-2 regression suite (10 tests): 9/10 passed on first run; test_recovery_deterministic failed only because it hardcoded Italian status strings while backend default is now 'en'. Updated that legacy test to pass lang='it' explicitly (preserving original intent) and it now passes. Total: 22/22 backend tests passing.
critical_code_review_comments: Localization logic is duplicated: PRESET_DIRECTIVES vs PRESET_DIRECTIVES_EN and two parallel prompt branches per LLM endpoint. Consider a single i18n dict / template layer keyed by lang to reduce drift risk when adding a new language.

AnalyzeResponse.confidence intentionally uses Italian keys (alta/media/bassa) even in EN responses - documented as intentional but exposes a leaky abstraction to English clients; consider mapping to high/medium/low at serialization time.
req.lang normalization ('en' if req.lang in ('en','it') else 'en') is repeated 5+ times - extract to a small helper (e.g., normalize_lang(req.lang)) for DRY.
MealPlanRequest.ingredients has no length cap or per-item length validation; malicious/very long lists could bloat the LLM prompt. Add Field(max_length=40) and per-item constraints.
server.py continues to grow (~1000 lines); still worth splitting into routers/food.py, routers/meal_plan.py, routers/coach.py.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (added lang='it' to test_recovery_deterministic since backend default lang is now 'en')
seed_data_creation: TEST_ prefixed device_id reused from iteration 2; no persistent seed data added beyond ephemeral CRUD entities cleaned up by the tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend now defaults lang='en'. Two test files exist: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (regression) and /app/backend/tests/test_lang_iter3.py (EN/IT + ingredients preset). Real JPEGs at /tmp/food.jpg, /tmp/img1.jpg, /tmp/img2.jpg. Language assertions use a keyword-frequency heuristic (IT_MARKERS vs EN_MARKERS) rather than strict equality - robust to LLM variance. meal_type keys in meal plans are intentionally kept as Italian internal keys (colazione/pranzo/cena/spuntino) regardless of lang.
rca of the issue: N/A - all endpoints working as designed. Only 'failure' was a stale hardcoded string in an iteration-2 test, now fixed.
